softwareClasses.title: Software classes
softwareClasses.description: Class codes as printed on the registry site: 06.09 for one class, 06 for the whole group. The Actor resolves them to the registry's internal filter ids, so you never need to open the site to fill this in.

platforms.title: Stores to search
platforms.description: Pick from the list. Free-form values used to be accepted here, and agents passed Ozon, ozon.ru and OZON for the same store.
